options.name: autostart
options.description: Specify if a given storage pool should be started automatically on system boot.

options.name: command
options.description: In addition to state management, various non-idempotent commands are available. See examples.

options.name: mode
options.description: Pass additional parameters to 'build' or 'delete' commands.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the storage pool being managed. Note that pool must be previously defined with xml.

options.name: state
options.description: Specify which state you want a storage pool to be in. If 'active', pool will be started. If 'present', ensure that pool is present but do not change its state; if it is missing, you need to specify xml argument. If 'inactive', pool will be stopped. If 'undefined' or 'absent', pool will be removed from I(libvirt) configuration. If 'deleted', pool contents will be deleted and then pool undefined.

options.name: xml
options.description: XML document used with the define command. Must be raw XML content using C(lookup). XML cannot be reference to a file.
